description: Step-03 domain_for_tag() branched to 'relationships' whenever the cluster contained any related-people reference, regardless of the tag itself. david-ohara appears in ~half of archived working files as related_people, so operational tags like omnifocus, chief, calendar, plaud, and daily-review were misclassified as relationships/. 11 semantic entries were created in relationships/ that should have lived under operational/.
correction: Domain should be derived from the TAG itself (person-named tag → relationships), not from the presence of any related-person field on the cluster's source files. Recovered by mv-ing the 11 misplaced files into operational/ before completing step-03.
systemic_fix: Rewrite domain_for_tag() in dream-cycle step-03 to only assign relationships when the tag itself is a person slug (kebab-case looks like first-last) or belongs to a curated relationships-tag list. Promote the step-03 script to systems/dream-cycle/ so it isn't rebuilt inline each cycle. Related to open err-20260703T081410-XDIYNH (same recommendation).
